v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est iustus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
text.en: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas, allelúia.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths, alleluia.

r.la: Et osténdit illi regnum Dei, allelúia.
r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God, alleluia.

text.la: O Doctor óptime, * Ecclésiæ sanctæ lumen, beáte Gregóri, divínæ legis amátor, deprecáre pro nobis Fílium Dei, allelúia.
text.en: O right excellent Teacher * Light of the Holy Church, Gregory, blessed lover of the Divine Law, pray for us to the Son of God, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum Gregórium minístrum tribuísti: præsta, quǽsumus; ut, quem Doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris, intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis.
text.en: O God, who didst give blessed Gregory to be thy people’s minister in eternal salvation; grant, we pray, that we who have him for teacher of life here on earth, may also deserve now that he is in heaven, to have him for an advocate.

office.title: S. Gregorii Nazianzeni Episcopi Confessoris et Ecclesiæ Doctoris
